entities.name: Pedro Murúa
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Pedro Murúa Leguizamon  was a Spanish field hockey player who competed in the 1960 Summer Olympics. He was born in San Sebastián and died in the same city, and was the grandson of Basque industrialist and politician Luis Lezama Leguizamón.
